body:
# Simon Willison’s Weblog

Releasedatasette-ports 0.4— Find all currently running Datasette instances and list their ports

My plugin for detecting and listing all Datasette instances on the current machine now works with the latest version, and displays the detected PID as well. Knowing the PID makes it easier to attach the new Python 3.15 profiler.

Posted 12th October 2026 at 4:57 am

Hello Python 3.15, goodbye 3.10, and now I can use 3.11 - 12th October 2026 A new feature for my blog, built using my voice - 9th October 2026 Claude Haiku 5.5 - 7th October 2026 We're going to need default hard budget caps on pretty much everything - 3rd October 2026

This is a **beat** by Simon Willison, posted on 12th October 2026.
